title: Order a vehicle history report
summary: You can order a vehicle history report online if you are considering buying a used car.
intro:
If you're considering buying a used car there are 2 types of vehicle checks you can make online:

For a fee, the vehicle history report includes:
what_you_need: the vehicle's NSW registration plate number

how_to_steps.text: Read and accept the Terms and Conditions.
Once your payment has been processed, download or email your report and transaction receipt.

more_info.text: The vehicle history report is not usable in court or certified for any legal evidence.
If you need information for legal proceedings you can request a certified copy from Transport for NSW Certificates Unit, Locked Bag 14, Grafton NSW 2460.
The vehicle history report is not available for conditionally-registered vehicles.
The free registration check can only be run on vehicles previously or currently registered in NSW, and includes:
the compulsory third party (CTP) insurer and policy expiry date.
The vehicle VIN will not be provided in this report.
